title: HyperFlow H3 Flash
description: Bring a picture to life: add your idea for the movement and let HyperFlow H3 Flash create a video with sound on your computer. Choose a Deno upscale finish when you want a larger result.

requirements.name: HyperFlowGGUFLoader
requirements.instructions: Install the reviewed HyperFlow H3 Flash loader on the local worker.

requirements.name: HyperFlowSigmas
requirements.instructions: Install the reviewed HyperFlow H3 Flash sampler schedule.

requirements.name: DenoMiniMaxH3TiledSampler
requirements.instructions: Install the separately reviewed Deno tiled sampler on the local worker.

requirements.name: MiniMaxH3AddGuide
requirements.instructions: Use a ComfyUI version with MiniMax H3 guide support.

requirements.name: minimax_h3_ref2va_hyperflow_flash_14b-Q4_K_M.gguf
requirements.instructions: Add the HyperFlow H3 Flash Ref2VA Q4 model to the worker's GGUF model list.

requirements.name: qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors
requirements.instructions: Add the MiniMax H3 text encoder.

requirements.name: minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors
requirements.instructions: Add the MiniMax H3 video VAE.

requirements.name: minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors
requirements.instructions: Add the MiniMax H3 audio VAE.

requirements.name: minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_conv_v1_fp16.safetensors
requirements.instructions: Add the MiniMax H3 latent upscaler.
